question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Extirpate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extirpate"** means to root out and destroy completely; it refers to eliminating or eradicating something entirely. (समूल नष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The government tried to extirpate corruption from the system through stringent policies.
 
 
 
• **"Establish"** means to set up or create something on a firm or permanent basis; it is the antonym of extirpate as it refers to building or founding something, rather than destroying it. (स्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to establish schools in remote areas to promote education.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Extirpate'** is **'Establish.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abolish** (समाप्त करना): To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to abolish outdated laws.
 
 
 
• **Remove** (हटाना): To take something away or eliminate it.
 
 
• **Example:** Please remove the old furniture from the room.
 
 
 
• **Erase** (मिटाना): To remove or obliterate something written, recorded, or stored.
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally erased the data from his computer.
 
 

35:T837,

The correct answer is **option 1.**</p&g
